note: Preflight gates passed; migration applied. Doctor primary among multiple active memberships is never confident evidence.

evidenceRules.confident_sole_active: Assigned doctor has exactly one active membership; users.organization_id is null or matches that sole org.
evidenceRules.confident_legacy_only: No active memberships; users.organization_id points at an existing organisation (transitional).
evidenceRules.manual_multi_org_ambiguous: Doctor has multiple active memberships — do not use primary.
evidenceRules.manual_sole_vs_legacy_conflict: Sole active membership disagrees with users.organization_id.
evidenceRules.unassigned: doctor_id IS NULL — leave organization_id null until association.
evidenceRules.missing_doctor_ref: doctor_id set but no doctors row.
